claims: Ime Udoka is the head coach of the Houston Rockets.
Ime Udoka has held the position of head coach of the Houston Rockets since being hired on April 25, 2023.
Ime Udoka was hired as the 15th head coach in Houston Rockets franchise history.
A YouTube video by Bossman Show uploaded on April 5, 2026, titled '03-27-26 Houston Rockets Coach Ime Udoka Pregame Interview', shows a pregame interview with Ime Udoka from March 2026.
Ime Udoka was the head coach of the Boston Celtics from 2021 to 2022.
Ime Udoka led the Boston Celtics to the NBA Finals.
Ime Udoka served as an assistant coach for the Brooklyn Nets.
Ime Udoka served as an assistant coach for the Philadelphia 76ers.
Ime Udoka served as an assistant coach for the San Antonio Spurs.
Ime Udoka was born in Portland, Oregon.
Ime Udoka played in the NBA.
Ime Udoka transitioned to coaching before joining the Rockets.
There was a satirical or incorrect report mentioned in search results regarding Ime Udoka's firing in March 2026.
April 2026 search results confirm Ime Udoka is still coaching the team.
